title: Afterlife of IO

presentation.description: IO's afterlife, between the Beginning and the Present: seven Memory Guardians, seven lost civilization archives, and the Veil at the end. The archive Gleebs needed, before IO came home to HoloVerse.

lore: An archive of the past that Gleebs carried into HoloVerse. After the Veil, IO became the HoloForge guide on the Flat-region ground.
